title: Binance Will List Illuvium (ILV)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Illuvium (ILV) and will open trading for ILV/BTC, ILV/BNB, ILV/BUSD, and ILV/USDT trading pairs at 2021-09-22 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  ILV  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for ILV will open at 2021-09-23 06:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is Illuvium (ILV)? Illuvium is a 3D, RPG blockchain game that involves collecting creatures and battling. ILV can be staked to be used as in-game currency, receive game revenue and vote for governance proposals. ILV Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
